subject: URGENT: Cross-region routing loop causing p95/p99 surge for Clearwave
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearwave.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T13:10:00Z
Subject: Re: API latency — production p95/p99 spike (live impact)

Hi Kimberly,

We're seeing a sudden jump in response times starting ~12:45 UTC across our EU users hitting your hosted API. p95 on our end shot up from ~180ms to ~820ms, and p99 spiked to >1.6s. We're also seeing a higher 5xx rate (500/502) for about 8% of requests during the window — attaching our small sample export (clearwave-impact-samples.csv) and a screenshot of our dashboard.

This is impacting our checkout flow; we are losing conversions. Can you confirm whether this is on Redwood's side or if something in our integration changed? We have request ids for a few failed calls if you need them.

We need an expedited investigation and an ETA on a fix. Please escalate if necessary.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Infrastructure — Clearwave Analytics
Attachments: clearwave-impact-samples.csv, latency-dashboard-20270522.png
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearwave.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T13:18:00Z
Subject: RE: API latency — production p95/p99 spike (live impact)

Hi Lena — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. We've escalated this internally and are treating it as a Sev 1 for Clearwave.

Immediate asks so we can triage faster: can you paste one or two failed request IDs (x-request-id header) and the exact endpoint path? Also, are all impacted clients in eu-west-1 or is it across multiple EU zones?

@Marissa — can you own the customer comms?
@Aditya/Dylan/Jordan — please take a look at routing/edge and infra metrics (especially inter-region egress, path traces, and BGP/peering changes in the last 2 hours).

I'll keep Lena copied — we'll update within 30 mins or sooner if we have a mitigation.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T13:36:00Z
Subject: RE: API latency — production p95/p99 spike (live impact)

Quick triage notes:
- I pulled packet captures and APM traces for a sample of Clearwave flows. I'm attaching packet-trace-clearwave-20270522.pcap.
- Evidence points to a cross-region routing loop/redistribution event: eu-west client traffic for several prefixes was being announced with a US-prepend and then re-routed back to our EU edge, creating an extra hop through us-west. That doubles RTT for affected flows and explains the p95/p99 inflation and several proxy timeouts.
- We saw a change in outbound prepends at 2027-05-22T12:41:12Z from one of our peering configs during a routine peering rollout (automated config push). The timing matches the spike window.
- Affected prefixes: 54.86.x.x/24 (sample), 34.200.x.x/24 (sample) — I confirmed flow logs showing eu-west -> us-west -> eu-west path for those.

Immediate mitigation I recommend: roll back the recent BGP prepend changes and temporarily pin Clearwave's traffic via eu-only routing policy. I can execute the rollback now if we approve.

-Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Network Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: packet-trace-clearwave-20270522.pcap
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearwave.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T13:42:00Z
Subject: RE: API latency — production p95/p99 spike (live impact)

Lena — apologies for the disruption. We can do two things right away:
1) Our network team recommends a rollback of the recent peering prepends (this should remove the extra hop) — Dylan can do this immediately.
2) If you prefer a traffic-level mitigation, we can failover your workload to a dedicated eu-only pool for the next 4 hours while we stabilize (this would require your sign-off).

If you want us to proceed with the rollback now, reply "Proceed" and we'll run it and confirm when RTT metrics return to baseline. We'll also prepare an incident postmortem and a credit offer for the impact window.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T14:32:00Z
Subject: RE: API latency — production p95/p99 spike (live impact)

Status update: we rolled back the automated peering prepends at 2027-05-22T14:12:38Z and applied a temporary eu-only routing ACL for Clearwave prefixes at 2027-05-22T14:15:04Z.
Observed impact:
- p95 (Clearwave sample) was ~820ms at peak; by 14:28 UTC it was down to ~210ms.
- p99 returned to ~420ms within 10 minutes.
- 5xx rate reduced to baseline (~0.6%).

I'll keep the eu-only ACL in place for 60 minutes and then carefully remove it after validating stability. We'll produce a detailed root cause and remediation plan covering automation rollbacks and extra guardrails for peering pushes.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: latency-dashboard-20270522.png
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearwave.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T15:05:00Z
Subject: Re: API latency — production p95/p99 spike (live impact)

Thanks — we saw latency come back down around 14:25 UTC and errors cleared. Appreciate the fast action and the offer of a credit — please send the postmortem and proposed credit amount when available.

Can you also confirm what guardrails you will put in place so this automation change doesn't result in a cross-region loop again? We have an incident review with our execs tomorrow and they'll want to understand the risk.

Best,
Lena
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearwave.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T15:05:00Z
Subject: RE: API latency — production p95/p99 spike (live impact) — next steps

Lena — thank you for the quick confirmation. We will:
- Publish a detailed postmortem by EOD tomorrow with timeline, root cause, and corrective actions.
- Add automated pre-deploy checks on peering prepends (geo-consistency checks + simulated path verification) and require a second approver for peering-related pushes.
- Issue a service credit for the impact window; Marissa will follow up w/ the credit amount and process.

I'll keep you posted and will set up a 30-min review with our infra and network leads if you'd like to walk through the postmortem live.

-Kim
